en-US.author: PDF-XChange Co Ltd.
en-US.description: All the features of PDF-XChange Editor Plus, PDF-Tools and PDF-XChange Standard in one economical bundle.
en-US.longDescription:
The PDF-XChange PRO V11 bundle combines three of PDF-XChange's applications:
- PDF-XChange Editor Plus – one of the fastest and most feature-rich applications used worldwide to create, view, edit and annotate PDF files.
- PDF Tools – a dynamic and user-friendly solution for the batch-creation and manipulation of industry-standard PDF and image files. Featuring eighty-eight default tools, as well as the option to clone, edit and create fully-customizable tools, it’s the ideal software to compliment your existing PDF facilities.
- PDF-XChange Standard – our virtual printer that is used to convert industry-standard file formats to PDF. It's compatible with files from almost all Windows applications such as MS Word, Excel and AutoCAD. It features an optimized, hybrid engine that significantly increases the quality of conversion for images and image-based text characters, and prints to both GDI and XPS.
The combination of these products makes it possible to create, view, edit and print PDF files to the highest levels of quality.
en-US.name: PDF-XChange PRO
en-US.releaseNotes:
PDF-XChange Editor
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
- Fixed some security and stability issues. Click here for further information.
- Fixed an issue with generating JPEG images with the CMYK color space.
- Fixed a rare issue with printing certain vector paths.
- Improved digital signature status detection.
- Fixed an issue with toggling the Quick Launch bar. (50499, 50372)
- Fixed an issue with "Booklet" mode in the print preview window—the paper dimensions are now swapped in some cases. (50532)
- Fixed some minor issues with UI automation.
- The "Set as default" option in the MSI installers is no longer enabled by default.
PDF-XChange Printer Standard
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
- Fixed an issue with preserving printer profiles when printing from MS Office apps. (T# 7801)

zh-CN.description: 将 PDF-XChange Editor Plus、PDF-Tools 和 PDF-XChange Standard 的所有功能整合进一个经济实惠的捆绑包中。
zh-CN.longDescription:
PDF-XChange PRO V11 软件包整合了 PDF-XChange 的三款应用程序：
- PDF-XChange Editor Plus —— 全球范围内用于创建、查看、编辑和注释 PDF 文件速度最快、功能最丰富的应用程序之一。此处可获取 PDF-XChange Editor 手册。
- PDF Tools —— 一款动态且用户友好的解决方案，用于批量创建和处理行业标准的 PDF 及图像文件。它内置 88 种默认工具，并支持克隆、编辑和创建完全自定义的工具，是完善您现有 PDF 设施的理想软件。此处可获取 PDF-Tools 用户手册。
- PDF-XChange Standard —— 我们的虚拟打印机，用于将行业标准的文件格式转换为 PDF。它兼容几乎所有 Windows 应用程序（如 MS Word、Excel 和 AutoCAD）的文件。它采用优化的混合引擎，显著提升了图像和基于图像的文字字符的转换质量，并支持打印到 GDI 和 XPS。此处可获取 PDF-XChange Standard 用户手册。
这些产品的结合使得以最高质量水平创建、查看、编辑和打印 PDF 文件成为可能。
